notes:
Account snapshot: Micronaut builds real-time personalization for trading desks and customer support bots. Very latency and cost sensitive — primary ask is consistent sub-40ms P95 inference for short chat turns and sub-20ms token times where possible. Shorthand notes from recent calls:

- 2024-09-10 discovery call (Maya/Liam) - product + infra. CTO (R. Alvarez) emphasized: "we need predictable p95 under spike, and unit economics that make sense for 100M messages/month."
- 2024-09-17 demo — Redwood hosted API demo + routing example. Liked routing fallback to cheaper model but worried about semantic drift.
- 2024-09-24 security review kickoff — asked for SOC2 + KMS flow + data residency proof. Provided initial security FAQ (drive link).
- 2024-10-01 POC scoping call with infra and ML teams. Agreed POC objectives and perf targets. Fireflies: ff_20241001_design-review.

POC requirements / success criteria (customer-specified):
- Workloads: mix of chat (short-turn conversational), embeddings (200k/day), on-the-fly reranking for search (latency critical).
- Perf targets: P95 end-to-end latency <= 40ms for chat generation (prompt + first token), steady throughput 150-250 requests/sec per shard, tail latency guarantees for spikes up to 1k RPS with burst capacity.
- Cost: target 35-50% unit cost reduction vs current managed endpoint; willing to trade small accuracy delta for big cost wins.
- Optimization levers requested: batching guidance (dynamic batch sizes by SLAs), KV/prefix caching for frequent prompts, 4-bit and 8-bit quantization profiles, kernel selection tuned for sequence length distribution.
- Benchmarking ask: Redwood to run perf bench across 3 candidate models (base FP16, 8-bit, 4-bit quantized) with same prompts and report: latency p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens at observed throughput. Prefer results in CSV + short slide summary.

Integration notes / constraints:
- Currently in AWS us-west-2 with strict egress controls; prefer VPC peering/private deployment or Dedicated.
- SSO via Okta (SAML), need role mapping and audit log retention 1 year.
- Data residency: trading metadata must remain in-region (NA) for compliance review.

Competitive context / why Redwood:
- Evaluated Anthropic and vendor X; Anthropic had good quality but variable latency under burst; vendor X cheaper but lacked caching primitives and rollout tooling. Micronaut wants a unified route: predictable latency + cost controls.

POC plan (agreed):
- Week 0: SOW + security questionnaire return (done).
- Week 1-2: Redwood runs perf bench (hosted/dedicated variants) on 3 model variants; deliver CSV and perf deck. (owner: Liam)
- Week 3: 2-week short POC where Micronaut runs in a dedicated pool with autoscale + caching enabled; compare costs vs baseline.
- Week 6: Go/no-go decision; procurement starts if go.

Risks / open items:
- Procurement wants hard SLA for 99.9 uptime and latency SLOs tied to credits.
- Need legal on data residency clause and KMS key handling for private deployments.
- Technical: customer wants to validate 4-bit quantization quality impact on reranking — needs evaluation harness (we offered Redwood Optimize + sample eval set).

Local notes for AE/SE:
- Prioritize perf numbers for 4-bit variant — customer specifically called this out twice.
- Prepare a short explainer on KV/prefix caching tradeoffs for chat vs reranking.
- Ask infra to pre-provision a dedicated node pool to reproduce spike scenario quickly.

Quoted direct: "If we can't show 30-40% cost win with acceptable quality, hard pass. But if latency and tail behavior are solved, we can move to Dedicated commit."
brief_description: Fintech firm evaluating Redwood Dedicated + Optimize for latency-sensitive chat, embeddings, and reranking. Wants perf benchmarks for quantized variants, batching/caching guidance, and VPC/dedicated deployment options.
